value.rationale: A mathematically natural exhaustive classification across all five Platonic solid graphs supplies exact finite complementability invariants. The 20-vertex dodecahedron, with full 120-element automorphism certificate and 30-edge rational currents, yields nontrivial strict rational norm asymmetry, and planar duality exchanges its two constants for the icosahedron. The results distinguish minimum projection norm from known metric distortion data; no unsupported infinite-family or optimal-minimizer uniqueness claim is made.
